title.narrative: Climate Finance Anchor Investment: Climate Evidence and Advice

description.narrative: The CEAP will increase Pacific countries resilience to climate change through improving the quality & availability of climate data, analysis & information for decision makers & communities. It aims to shift the Pacific’s weather, climate & early warning services from “describing the expected conditions” to communicating expected impacts to communities and “what it will mean for communities" It will be delivered through three workstreams focusing on development of Pacific capability and capacity.
